description: Hearing-aid driver response at the eardrum, measurement probe tube
rationale: In the reference condition the measurement probe tube microphone was hanging loosely around the ear (Documentation.pdf); its signal is not an eardrum pressure, although it is stored as a number.

description: Hearing-aid driver response at the eardrum, reference probe tube
rationale: The reference probe tube was inserted through a dedicated bore in the earmold and used only for earmold measurements; for domes no reference-probe eardrum pressure exists.

description: Hearing-aid driver response at the hearing-aid microphone (feedback path)
rationale: The hearing-aid microphone is part of the device and always present.

description: Loudspeaker response at the eardrum, measurement probe tube
rationale: In the reference condition the measurement probe tube was hanging loosely around the ear; the stored loudspeaker response then measures the free field, not the eardrum.

description: Loudspeaker response at the eardrum, reference probe tube
rationale: The reference probe tube was available for earmolds only; dome conditions store the loosely hanging reference microphone instead.

description: Hearing threshold measured with the hearing-aid driver
rationale: Thresholds are behavioural and exist for all earpieces/conditions.

description: Real-ear unaided response (open ear, one insertion per participant)
rationale: Measured in the open ear with the measurement probe in place and one insertion per participant; used as the unaided (open-ear) reference of the real-ear occluded insertion gain.
